buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Service Nomenclature: Hiring of Skilled Electrical Motor Winder as per OFI Specification/Scope of Work No. 07/EMS/PROC./OFI/0176

Dt. 20/07/2024. 1.Pre-qualification/ Eligibility Criteria: i.)Eligibility Criteria: The Contractor shall have a valid Class-A electrical contractor license and authority to carry out the electrical work in Madhya Pradesh in accordanc e with the rules and conditions issued by the Govt. of Madhya Pradesh under electrici ty notification No. 1319/627/XIII Dated 13/04/1960 and an amendments issued later on. The Contractor shall submit the valid documents in support of the eligibility criteri a along with the Bid. ii)Experience: The bidder should have successfully executed/ completed at least : a)One single order of value equal to or more than ₹ 8,87,732.252/- OR b)Two orders each of value equal to or more than ₹ 5,54,832.72/- OR c)Three orders each of value equal to or more than ₹ 4,43,866.176/- for similar services(s) (i.e. Providing of Manpower) in last three years to any Central Govt./ State Govt. Organization/ PSU/Public Listed Company. Copies of contracts/ wor k orders and documentary evidence of successful execution/ completion in support of Past experience. Minimum Experience should be of one year. iii)Annual Turnover: The tenderer should have an average annual turnover of at le st ast ₹ 3,32,899.63/- during last 03 consecutive years, ending 31 march of the financ ial years, The relevant documents for confirming the turnover of last 03 years (2023- 24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) duly certified by “Chartered Accountant” should be submit ted along with technical bid. The firms who have valid registration of Start-up/MSE will be exempted fro m the bid condition of prior experience (Point No. ii) and prior turnover (Poi nt No. iii). No exemption in Eligibility Criteria will be provided. 2.Essential parameter of the tender: i) Compliance to Service nomenclature / specification/special terms and condition for Manpower service contracts ii) Co mpliance to Pre-qualification criteria & iii) Compliance of inspection clause, are t he essential parameters of the tender. 3.Educational Qualification and Experience for the workers: As per attac hed Specification/Scope of Work.

4.Price Variation Clause: Applicable as per Govt. Guidelines for revision in Mi nimum Wages 5.EMD: Applicable, The quoting firm must upload scanned copy of EMD in the b id and forward the hard copy of the same within 5 days of bid opening, failing w hich the bid may be treated as incomplete & may lead to rejection of the bid. Th e MSME firms with valid UDYAM Registration Certificate, firms registered with C entral Purchase organization, MoD or any Ordnance Factory, Central PSUs and v erified startups are exempted from submission of EMD. 6.Inspection: Final Inspection at Buyer’s premise (on the basis of job completi on certificate) by CGM/OFI or his authorized representative. 7.Public Procurement for MSEs, Order 2012: Applicable, Firm should submi t valid UDYAM Registration Certificate to claim purchase preference. 8.Performance Security Deposit: Applicable @ 5% of total contracted value. PSD should remain valid up till at least 60 days beyond the date of completion o f all contractual obligations of the supplier. It should be given in the form of Ban k guarantee or Fixed deposit receipt & it should be drawn in favour of ‘Munitions India Limited, Ordnance Factory Itarsi’.
